messages.content: 1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.content:
在 1800 年，英格蘭（實際上是大不列顛及愛爾蘭王國）的君主是 **George III**。他的全名是：

**George William Frederick Ernest**（即 George III，英國及愛爾蘭國王）
message.reasoning: We need to answer: "1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？" That is Chinese: "What was the full name of the king of England in 1800?" In 1800, the monarch was King George III. Full name: George William Frederick Ernest? Wait, George III's full name: George William Frederick Ernest? Let's recall: George III (George William Frederick Ernest) was King of Great Britain and Ireland from 1760 to 1820. Actually his full name: George William Frederick Ernest. He was known as George III. So answer: George William Frederick Ernest. But maybe they want "George William Frederick Ernest, King of Great Britain and Ireland". Provide that. Use Chinese. Also mention that he was King of Great Britain and Ireland. Provide full name.
